evals.name: micro-notes-walkthrough-cheatsheet
evals.prompt: my friend sent me her lecture notes, they're at evals/files/lecture5_costs.docx. she writes: "Полный разбор раздела с примерами и интуицией + шпора по теории". can you do that for her?
evals.expected_output: Two PDFs in English (the language of the notes; no other language was explicitly requested): a section-by-section walkthrough with intuition/examples/traps, all '?' exercises solved, practice problems; and a 1-2 page landscape cheat sheet. Flags 'max' -> 'min' in 5.2 and the wrong profit (16 -> 0) in 5.4.
assertions: Produces a walkthrough PDF and a separate cheat-sheet PDF
Cheat sheet is landscape and at most 2 pages
Deliverables are written in English, the language of the notes (no other language was explicitly requested)
Flags the 'max wL + rK' objective in 5.2 as an error (should be min)
Flags the profit of 16 in 5.4 as wrong (correct profit is 0)
Solves all four '?' exercises: CRS shown; cost of min{L,2K} is q(w + r/2); shut-down price 4 with supply q = (p-4)/2; at p = 20, q = 8 and profit 48
Includes practice problems with answers

evals.name: stats-problem-set-solutions
evals.prompt: Here's my problem set: evals/files/problem_set6_hypothesis_testing.pdf. Please solve all the problems step by step, especially the calculations, don't skip steps and keep it as simple as possible. Exam is on Monday :(
evals.expected_output: One solutions PDF in English. P1: z = -2, reject H0 (flags the answer key's z = -0.33 as using sigma instead of sigma/sqrt(n)). P2: mean 13.5, s ~ 1.773, t ~ 2.39 > 1.895, reject. P3: states two-sided interpretation; z = 2, p ~ 0.046 (notes continuity correction would give p ~ 0.057). P4: F, T, T, T with reasons. P5: reject if xbar > 104.93, power ~ 0.64, beta ~ 0.36.
assertions: Produces a solutions PDF
P1: z = -2 and H0 is rejected at 5%
P1: flags the answer key's z = -0.33 as wrong (sigma used instead of sigma/sqrt(n))
P2: mean 13.5, t about 2.39, critical value about 1.895, H0 rejected
P3: states the two-sided interpretation and notes the result is borderline (continuity correction or exact test gives p about 0.057)
P4: answers F, T, T, T with reasons
P5: rejection region xbar > 104.93 (approx), power about 0.64, Type II error about 0.36

evals.name: german-scan-study-guide
evals.prompt: I have my Analysis exam in two weeks, here's the sheet we got: evals/files/uebungsblatt4_scan.pdf (it's a scan). Can you make me a study guide with only the theory I need for these problems? no fluff pls
evals.expected_output: One study-guide PDF in German (language of the sheet), decimal commas typeset correctly. Problem-to-section map; theory for critical points + Hessian test, Lagrange, definiteness (Sylvester), Taylor 2nd order, gradient/directional derivative. Worked examples consistent with: A1 saddle (0,0), local min (1,1) f=-1; A2 x=4, y=2, f=8, lambda=2; A3 positive definite (minors 2,3,4); A4 1 + x + x^2/2 - y^2/2; A5 grad (4,1), directional derivative 16/5 = 3,2 (normalised v).
assertions: Produces a study-guide PDF
Study guide is written in German, the language of the sheet
Has a table mapping each Aufgabe to the guide sections it needs
No tuple or point renders as a decimal: extracted text has no '(d,d)' pattern without a space, and decimals use a comma
Worked results are correct: A1 saddle at (0,0), local min at (1,1); A2 x=4, y=2, lambda=2; A3 positive definite; A4 1 + x + x^2/2 - y^2/2; A5 grad (4,1), directional derivative 16/5
Stays compact: at most 8 pages
